Want to start making passive income with music but have zero musical talent or equipment? In this video, I’ll show you the exact step-by-step process to write, produce, package, and distribute your own original songs using AI. You can do this entirely from your laptop in under an hour and get your music on major streaming platforms like Spotify, Apple Music, and YouTube!

Whether you want to create soulful R&B, catchy pop, or relaxing lo-fi, these AI tools make it incredibly easy to generate high-quality tracks and start earning royalties. Watch until the end to see how to scale this process and maximize your earnings!

Claude AI - For writing lyrics and generating image prompts.

Suno AI - For generating the full audio track (vocals and instruments). Note: You need a paid subscription (starting at $10/month) for commercial rights!

Be Specific: When prompting AI for lyrics, give it specific genres, moods, and inspirations (e.g., "Smooth soulful R&B inspired by SZA").

Always Download WAV: Streaming platforms require high-quality lossless audio formats. Never use MP3s for distribution!

Perfect Your Cover Art: Make sure your album cover is exactly 3000 x 3000 pixels so it doesn't get rejected by platforms.

Leverage YouTube: YouTube pays out multiple types of royalties, including when other creators use your music in their videos.
